msg: Hi, 3 of us, all Rescue divers from Germany, we're on Isla Grande and have our own full gear. We want 3 dives including one at night. Price with our own gear? Can you do Nitrox?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That sounds like a great day of diving around Isla Grande! The 3-dive plan includes two daytime dives and one night dive. It includes dive equipment, so bringing your own complete gear doesn’t add a discount to this plan.

Yes, Nitrox is available on request for divers certified in Nitrox. Would you like to book the 3-dive plan? https://book.divingplanet.org/book/package-of-3-dives-already-on-island/22?language=en

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 188 USD · 209 USD

Groups of 5 or more get a 10% group discount, on top of the 10% online discount, on recreational diving, the mini-course and snorkeling (not on PADI courses); it is not applied automatically: it has to be requested from the team before paying.

Has it been *more than 2 years* since any diver in the group last dived?

msg: No, we dived 2 months ago. All 3 of us want the 3 dives. Book it, what do we do now?
reply:
Perfect! Since you all dived two months ago, the refresher requirement doesn’t apply. Your plan is set up for three people, but I can’t confirm the booking here. To continue, complete the booking through this link and select your date and group size: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/package-of-3-dives-already-on-island/22?language=en

Bring your certification cards. Pick-up is between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m. if your accommodation has boat access; the night-dive pick-up is at 5:30 p.m. Lunch isn’t included. After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying.

🤿 *3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive) - already on the islands*
💰 *188 USD* per person (online rate) · 3 people
✅ Includes: hotel pick-up (if there is maritime/boat access), dive insurance, diving equipment and a PADI professional accompanying the activity.
📍 Pickup at your island hotel.

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/package-of-3-dives-already-on-island/22?language=en

Is there anything else I can help you with? I can *add another activity*, answer questions, or adjust your booking. 🤿
